messages:
ana: Saw duplicates in onboarding when a 429 hit during token rotation — two POST /users.
sam: Which SDK? repro?
ana: Node v1.4.2 sampleapp repro, Python customer report too. Flow: 429 -> refresh -> immediate retry -> duplicate.
jordan: Race between refresh handlers.
mike: Short fixes: add jitter to refresh retries, auto-add X-Redwood-Idempotency in sampleapp for provisioning calls (opt-out), and add auth probe endpoint.
emily: Also need SDK parity: node exposes retry hook; python needs same.
sam: devx-bot: Created INF-2501 (sdk helper), INF-2502 (auth probe), INF-2503 (sampleapp).
mike: I'll take INF-2501; emily INF-2502; ana INF-2503.
jordan: Patch sketch: sleep(base + rand(jitter)), probe auth, set idempotency header if absent, retry. Deterministic RNG for tests.
ana: We'll add telemetry dx.onboard.auto_idempotency=1 when sampleapp enables it.
sam: Schedule fixes for this sprint; support playbook in case customers report duplicates.
